description: Which segment counts a call or tool recorded while a pause or the final end delivers events. Usage recorded during pause delivery belongs to the paused segment, counted once, with its own call and tool events; the final end refuses it, as any write after end.

cases.name: wrapper call recorded during paused call delivery
cases.description: A held span call event is delivered by pause; the app's transport callback records another call. The paused segment counts both.

cases.name: span call recorded during paused call delivery
cases.description: The late call is a held span too, so pause delivers it in the same pass before capturing totals.

cases.name: call recorded during paused call delivery, then JSON restore
cases.description: Nothing recorded during delivery is left pending in the snapshot.

cases.name: settled tool recorded during paused call delivery
cases.description: A tool recorded with its result during delivery counts in the paused segment and sends its declared event once.

cases.name: span answer recorded during paused call delivery
cases.description: The paused response keeps the answer captured before delivery; a span answer recorded by the callback does not replace it.

cases.name: span answer recorded by a tool event during paused call delivery
cases.description: A tool recorded during delivery sends its declared event at pause; a span answer its callback reports does not replace the answer captured before delivery.

cases.name: span recorded by a tool event during paused call delivery
cases.description: Delivery records a tool whose declared event, sent at pause, reports a held span; pause delivers that span's call event too before capturing totals.

cases.name: nested spans recorded during paused call delivery, then another span
cases.description: Delivery of the held call records a parent span and its child; the parent is filtered as the child's nested twin, and delivery of the child's event records one more span. Every counted call sends its event before the totals are captured.

cases.name: nested spans recorded during paused call delivery, then another span, then JSON restore
cases.description: The same run continued from the JSON snapshot: nothing recorded during delivery is left for, or sent again by, the restored run.

cases.name: overflow calls recorded behind a held span during paused response delivery
cases.description: With max_calls_per_interaction 1, delivery of the paused response records a span, whose call event is held, and two calls past the cap. They are pending for the next segment, and the folded pair sends one call event after the span's.

cases.name: overflow calls recorded behind a held span during paused response delivery, then JSON restore
cases.description: The same run continued from the JSON snapshot: the folded pair's unsent call event is restored with the pending calls and sent once.

cases.name: call recorded during final call delivery is not counted
cases.description: The final end delivers a held span call event after the interaction ended, so a call the callback records is refused, as any write after end is.
